title: Andrey Zvyagintsev believes filmmakers know what the audience wants — not executives
description: The year is 2022. Vladimir Putin has announced the military draft. In Andrey Zvyagintsev's Minotaur, set in the fictional town of Krasoborsk, a quietly unhappy couple, called Gleb and Galina, carry on with their lives, or try to, geopolitics notwithstanding. For Galina, carrying on means an affair, which we deduce from a scene of her […]
